title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function f(x) might transform the x-values to fit the y-values. What kind of transformation does the pattern suggest?

title: Analyzing Quadratic Functions
text: Think about how a quadratic function, like $$f(x)=x^2$$, affects the values of $$x$$. How does squaring $$x$$ change the shape of the data? Does this match the pattern you see in the scatterplot?

title: Evaluating $$f(x)=x^2$$
text: Does the pattern of the data points suggest a parabolic shape, which is characteristic of a quadratic function?
